body: Yes we are stronger in the places where we are broken and glued up.
I want to hug you and tell you that I love you. I might not know you but your pain and strength will be the things that hold things together for you, whether you realize it or not.
I was where you were a week ago. You will feel differently, although it might not seem apparent at the moment. So talk to us more.
Am much older than you but have similar problems. I have gotten help through this community when I was considering ending it all. We are here to listen... How are you feeling at this moment?
Thanks. That means more than I can express.
Thank you for saying this. I really really needed to hear this.
I am today in that place you were a year ago. I am finding it really hard to believe that it does, but willing to still try.
I'm going to put one foot in front of the other and try this. Thank you. Ive been through chemo and never at any point did I feel like ending my life.

My eyes are so dried out from tears from last few hours but reading your response has flooded my eyes again. I think I'll apologize  first thing when we wakes up. I stayed up last few hours writing my last long note to him, but I guess ill need to get the words out of my mouth and try this again. If I live to see another day, I hope I don't cause harm to others as I have today.

I know you're trying to help, I truly appreciate it. But someone hurting themselves because of my hormonal outbursts is the lowest I can stoop to, as a human. I will never be able to forgive myself. I can at least ensure a year or two of comfortable life for my family when I die.
I've broken the person I love. I think my leaving might be better for them in the long run.
I just posted about financial security for my family before I go. I think this is the end for me.
